models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B

engines.quant: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B; established 70-100 tok/s decode and 1,500 tok/s prefill across RTX 3090/4090/5090 (per Niko Veit's measurements)

models.why: Coldniko's cross-card 125B MoE figures were quoted as 70-100 tok/s decode and 1,500 tok/s prefill on RTX 3090, 4090 and 5090 — the 3090 figure taken as the 24GB-class entry; prefill figures excluded from the decode rank.
